# Version 4.151.0
> **Managed perf ports and m151** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bumps to Skia m151 and ports several hot color/interop paths to managed C# for lower overhead. Color conversion, premultiply math, HarfBuzz UTF-8 buffering, and tag parsing all move off P/Invoke and onto zero-allocation managed code, alongside a WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 update and a native resource-leak fix in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Bumped to Skia milestone m151** — Updates the bundled engine to Skia m151 and merges the intervening upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## API Surface

- **GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe** — Removes the unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions usage, simplifying consuming code. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed in SKImage.FromEncodedData** — Fixes a native resource leak in the SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) overload. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color and pixel math ported to managed C#** — SKColor → SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run entirely in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, and SKColor hex parsing gets a ReadOnlySpan<char> overload. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **HarfBuzzSharp hot paths made allocation-free** — HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now uses pooled UTF-8 encoding instead of allocating, Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse drop their per-call char[4] allocation, SKShaper reads glyph results via zero-copy spans, and SKData.SaveTo avoids an extra buffer copy. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Platform

- **WASM updated for .NET 11 exception handling** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Ports HarfBuzzSharp's UTF-8 buffer encoding and tag parsing to allocation-free managed code, and switches SKShaper glyph reads to zero-copy spans.
